label: Q1
question: Is there a prompt injection surface? (Any user-controlled input reaches the LLM)

subs.question: Is RAG / retrieval used?
subs.result: PI-DEF-2 REQUIRED — RAG context labeling + load-time sanitization

subs.question: Does the system have tool permissions?
subs.result: AGENCY-DEF-1 REQUIRED — minimal tool permission allowlist

subs.question: Can high-risk tool calls occur? (email, file write, API with side effects)
subs.result: AGENCY-DEF-2 REQUIRED — HITL with context provenance

label: Q2
question: Is this multi-agent, MCP, or A2A? (More than one LLM agent in the call chain)
result: MA-DEF-1 REQUIRED — context isolation + inter-agent provenance tagging

label: Q3
question: Can an attacker control or shape: task definition · validator/schema · incomplete data · uploaded documents · tool results · marketplace skills · workflow bundles?
result: ISC-DEF-1 REQUIRED — validate the harness itself (task + validator + data), not just model output

label: Q4
question: Is any model, adapter, skill, MCP server, or dependency third-party?
result: SC-DEF-1 + SC-DEF-2 REQUIRED — AIBOM + inference sandboxing + network egress monitoring
